params.name: teeth
params.label: Teeth
params.help: Saw teeth round the wheel: 6 to 200.

params.name: tip
params.label: Tip radius
params.help: From the axis to the tips of the teeth.

params.name: root
params.label: Root radius
params.help: From the axis to the bottom of a notch: 0.3 to 0.97 of the tip radius.

params.name: pin
params.label: Arbor pin, mm
params.help: The steel pin through its axis: 1, 1.5, 2 or 3 mm, or none for no bore.

params.name: fit
params.label: Fit on the pin
params.help: Running turns freely on the pin (H9/d9), sliding slides on by hand (H7/h6), press holds it (H7/p6).

params.name: allowance
params.label: Hole allowance
params.help: How much this printer makes a small hole undersize. A fit coupon measures it.
